The handler-thread 'straight write before the drain starts' (AC-5, AC-6) has no stream to write to on TinyHttpd under the frozen add-only SPI. SPI gap (substantiated): NaruServe-api/src/main/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/spi/HttpExchange.java:89 eventStream(int, List, StreamDrain) returns void and spi/StreamDrain.java:13 drain(OutputStream) is the only place the core receives the stream; on TinyHttpd the drain is run only after the handler returned (FR-SSE-003 AC-2), and IR-HTTP-007 AC-4 / IR-WS-002 AC-5 allow no SPI member besides HttpExchange.webSocket and the three WebSocket types.
